title: Axolotl: egg to adult

scenes.headline: …and it keeps its feathery gills for life
Critically Endangered in the wild
scenes.body: Most axolotls people see, like this one, live in aquariums.

caption:
From a dot in jelly to a pink adult that never fully grows up.

A female axolotl can lay 100 to 300 eggs, attaching them to plants or rocks under water.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Ambystoma mexicanum). Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: True life-stage sequence (egg → embryo → adult), but different individuals stand in for each stage; the adult is an aquarium animal and is described as such.
